_about: The separation cascade (decision 0023): every model the levels can load, with its source, licence as read at the source, the number its author or the MVSep tables report, and its size. Nothing here is downloaded at install time: the Space fetches a file on first use and checks its SHA-256. `licence_class` is what the cascade enforces: 'open' (MIT or Apache, any use), 'copyleft' (GPL-3.0 weights, used at run time on the Space and never redistributed by this repository), 'nc' (non-commercial: allowed only for this research demo, with attribution and the note in the credits), 'unverified' (no licence stated at the source: off unless the owner enables it). SDR values are the sources' own, on their own sets, and are not comparable across sets; the set is named in `sdr.set`.

sdr.set: the author's own validation set (named in the file)

anvuew_dereverb.notes: Fine-tuned from Kim's vocal model on dry mono single-voice recordings: it pulls stereo and layered vocals towards mono and removes some non-centre harmonies (the author's card). The cascade therefore guards it (bypass when the dry output falls more than 10 dB, as the SJTU X-LANCE system does) and uses the model-free dereverberator for every other stem.

best.why: Every level, the vocal ensemble and the model dereverberator on the vocals.

fast.why: One vocal model, no karaoke split, no model dereverb, the kit by the DSP rules: the levels that carry the most audible placement for the least GPU time.

cpu.why: No GPU: the four-stem fallback chain (SoundStage Separator, then htdemucs) and the model-free levels.

ensemble.weights_note: Per-band weights are fitted on a validation set by scripts/fit_ensemble.py and written here; until they are fitted the cascade uses equal weights and says so in run.json.
